answer.outline: Tests run without live payment/email/API dependencies; state is isolated and cleaned up; CI fails when a contract regression is introduced.
suggested_steps: Arrange, act, assert and avoid asserting internal library behavior.
Use fixtures to control setup/teardown and temporary paths.
Mock network calls at the application boundary rather than calling production systems.
